_comment: Golden fixture for bot/scripts/lib/proto-evm.mjs encodeMsgDelegateEVM (CH-010a). Hex values were generated by running the encoder itself against these inputs and are pinned here to catch regressions (e.g. a field-number transposition) — not an external proto reference. This is the intended future shared golden source for the src/grants.ts TS copy of the same encoder (CH-010b, deferred); keep both encoders' output byte-identical to these hexes once that sync lands.

longAmountField._note: Synthetic — no real amount is ever this long. Exercises encodeVarint's multi-byte length-prefix branch (TEST-QA TQA-012), which no real fixture input reaches (all real fields stay under the 127-byte single-byte varint boundary).
